faqs.question: Do you work with local businesses (clinics, salons, retail) as well as startups?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have two specialized tracks: (1) High-ROI Local Business Growth packages covering Google Maps #1 ranking, fast mobile websites, automated 5-star Google review systems, and WhatsApp booking bots; and (2) Full-stack SaaS, custom web apps, AI agents, and performance marketing for scaling startups and enterprises.

faqs.question: How fast can you launch our website, WhatsApp automation, or ad campaign?
faqs.answer: Conversion websites, local business systems, and WhatsApp CRM automations typically go live in 10 to 14 days. Custom SaaS platforms, e-commerce storefronts, and multi-agent AI systems are delivered in 3 to 5 weeks with weekly live staging previews.

faqs.question: How does your pricing work? Are there any hidden retainers?
faqs.answer: Zero hidden fees. Every engagement starts with a transparent, fixed-scope architecture blueprint and milestone schedule. Whether you need a one-time website + WhatsApp bot build or an ongoing monthly SEO & Ads growth engine, you see exact deliverables and pricing upfront.

faqs.question: Do we own 100% of our website source code, ad accounts, and customer data?
faqs.answer: 100% yes. Unlike lock-in agencies, you retain full administrative ownership of your GitHub repository, domain, cloud hosting, Google Business Profile, Meta/Google Ad accounts, and WhatsApp CRM database from day one.

faqs.question: How does the 15% Referral Partner Commission work?
faqs.answer: If you introduce a founder, clinic owner, retail brand, or business that signs a project with SkyLine Digital, we pay you a direct 15% commission on the project value via UPI or bank transfer as soon as their onboarding invoice clears.
